critique_points.title: Upstand height
critique_points.reason: The felt only turns up the wall a little. Water blown against the parapet can get over it.
critique_points.why: The membrane has to turn up high enough that standing or wind-driven water cannot get over the top of it and into the wall.
critique_points.question: How far above the finished roof should the membrane turn up, and where would you finish its top edge?

critique_points.title: Nothing under the coping
critique_points.reason: There is no damp-proof layer shown under the coping, so water that gets past the coping joints can run down inside the wall.
critique_points.why: Coping joints are not watertight forever. A layer under the coping catches what gets through.
